name: Potion of Speed
summary: A potion that grants the effect of Haste without its lethargy.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the *{ref:spell/haste}* spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.

This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.
